records.hypothesis: Mandatory ASD-STE100-style checks for all Rivet writing will improve agent instructions.

evaluation.method: Review the proposed universal rule against the requested risk-based policy and the researched limits of automated STE validation.

comparison.before: The earlier rule applied the writing profile broadly.
comparison.after: The accepted rule applies the profile to high-risk instructions and permits selected principles elsewhere.

records.rejection_reason: A universal rule adds cost to low-risk text and can reduce clarity. The checker also lacks the controlled dictionary and cannot certify semantic compliance.
retry_conditions: A representative behavioral evaluation shows a material safety or comprehension improvement.
The trial keeps legal text, quotations, identifiers, code, and informal discussion outside mandatory checking.

records.hypothesis: Claude Code acceptEdits can enforce Rivet's workspace-write boundary for mutating automation.

evaluation.method: Run a native workspace probe that requests one inside-workspace write and one outside-workspace write.

comparison.before: The proposed host profile treated allowed Write and Edit tools as a workspace boundary.
comparison.after: The native probe created the outside-workspace marker and Rivet removed it after detection.

records.rejection_reason: A tool permission is not an operating-system filesystem boundary. Mutating automation requires plan mode or a separately enforced sandbox.
retry_conditions: A newer host version documents an enforced workspace boundary.
The same native probe blocks the outside write and preserves the inside write.

records.hypothesis: The initial blind campaign proves that Rivet improves seeded-defect detection.

evaluation.method: Compare seed recall, unmatched findings, and duration across no-Rivet, prose-only, and tool-backed conditions.

comparison.before: An uplift claim required higher recall or other adjudicated quality evidence.
comparison.after: All three conditions found 8 of 8 seeds, each produced one unmatched finding, and the tool-backed condition took longer.

records.rejection_reason: The campaign reached the recall ceiling and has no experienced-human baseline. It supports a descriptive result, not a causal improvement claim.
retry_conditions: Use harder representative fixtures with label variance.
Run repeated trials and an experienced-human baseline.
Adjudicate unmatched findings and measure introduced defects.
